notes.title: Dread Tomb - v1.19 Update log
notes.notes:
▲ Fixed the issue of "777" magnification and unlocking achievement in the fruit machine during shaking
▲ Fix the issue of excessive spider health
▲ Fixed the issue of being able to pick up items in Bo Xi
▲ Fix the problem of detonators not exploding immediately when thrown out and encountering monsters
▲ Fixed the issue where changing microphone input devices sometimes does not take effect
▲ Fixed the issue of not being able to play emoji animations when using the controller
Adjusting trees or stones that have been hit by a car will no longer cause collisions with the car
Adjusting the buried area around the car will bounce it up, making it easier for the car to get out of trouble
▲ Adjust and reduce the total number of monsters in level four or five underground palaces
▲ Adjust the prices of some items
▲ Adjust monster respawn time
▲ Adjusting the monsters in the wild will make them relatively dispersed
Adjusting the speed of time passing will slow down as the map level increases

notes.title: V1.17 version update
notes.notes:
v1.17

▲ Sometimes getting stuck in the terrain when repairing the underground palace
▲ Adjust to default to encrypted room when creating a room
▲ Adjusting to be killed twice by monsters will also unlock the encyclopedia
▲ Adjust some monster mechanisms to make them easier to understand
▲ Adjust the illustration description to be more detailed
▲ Adjust the first level image to prevent the appearance of facial monsters
▲ Added in-game prompt to disable family sharing
▲ Add microphone device selection box in room information
▲ Add microphone volume adjustment in room information
▲ Delete button for automatically setting image quality parameters
▲ Delete the spider monster, it will be reopened after adjustment
